name: OpenCode
blurb: Open-source terminal coding agent with a built-in Nebius Token Factory provider: run /connect, pick Nebius Token Factory, paste your API key, and drive open models like Kimi K2 and Qwen3-Coder straight from the CLI over Token Factory's OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

name: Hugging Face smolagents
blurb: Hugging Face's minimalist code-agent framework runs on Token Factory by setting provider="nebius" in InferenceClientModel, so smolagents CodeAgents execute tool calls against Nebius-hosted open models (Qwen, Llama, DeepSeek) through the Inference Providers routing layer.

name: LLM Gateway
blurb: Open-source unified LLM gateway (theopenco) that routes, manages, and tracks requests across providers; its Nebius provider exposes Token Factory open models (Qwen3, DeepSeek V3, Kimi K2, Llama Nemotron) with streaming, tool calling, vision, and JSON output behind one OpenAI-compatible API.

name: Pipecat
blurb: Open-source framework for real-time voice and multimodal agents ships a NebiusLLMService that extends its OpenAI service to hit Token Factory at api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1; install pipecat-ai[nebius], set NEBIUS_API_KEY, and stream low-latency conversational responses from Nebius-hosted open models.
